up: For the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293277 (Niemann-Pick C1 intracellular cholesterol transporter 1), retrieve the ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assays where the assay organism is Homo sapiens.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293277') AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
